name: Implementation Quality
description: Write or modify production code to a strict, evidence-gated standard: features, bug fixes, refactors, services, libraries, CLIs, workers, and application logic. Use whenever real application code is being implemented or changed, or when asked whether code is production-ready. Bans placeholders, dead code, silent failures, and unverified completion claims.
verification_requirements: focused test for the changed behavior
repository gates the change can affect (lint, type check, build)
final diff inspected; no placeholders, stubs, or disabled checks
provenance: janefskills 1.2.0 engineering-standard (truth policy, forbidden list, workflow)
